summary_en: Full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 revised to 203 yen per share (interim 65 yen, year-end 138 yen comprising ordinary dividend of 118 yen plus commemorative dividend of 20 yen) from previous forecast of 168 yen, reflecting upward earnings revision and 70th anniversary celebration.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Implementation of 70th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Yamaichi Electronics revised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to 203 yen per share, comprising an interim dividend of 65 yen and a year-end dividend of 138 yen. The year-end dividend consists of an ordinary dividend of 118 yen and a commemorative dividend of 20 yen, compared to the previous forecast of 168 yen announced in August 2026.

The upward revision reflects stronger-than-expected performance in the test solutions business, particularly from sales of test sockets for smartphones and wearable devices, as well as burn-in sockets for memory products. The company's mid-term management plan targets a dividend payout ratio of 30%. The additional commemorative dividend of 20 yen marks the company's 70th anniversary, which it reached on November 1, 2026, and is intended to express gratitude to shareholders and other stakeholders. The commemorative dividend is subject to approval at the company's ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 2027.
